_comment: Divergences between this chart's system layer and the template it was forked from that somebody has read and decided are correct. A fresh chart has none: it starts identical, and every entry here is a deliberate decision not to mirror something. Checked by scripts/check-template-parity.mjs. The digest is over the diff itself, so an entry covers the divergence that was actually read: the moment either side changes that file again the digest moves, the acknowledgement lapses, and the path comes back into the report. Regenerate an entry with `npm run parity -- --pin` and write a real reason — an entry whose reason is a shrug is an exemption sitting on a check it cannot justify.

_shape.path: repo-relative path, as check-template-parity.mjs prints it
_shape.digest: sha256 of `git diff <ref> -- <path>`, first 16 hex chars — run --pin
_shape.reason: why this difference is correct and should not be mirrored
